victory.step: Remove 11 Sloth cubes to Wakefulness (wake up).
Become surfaced by ending turn on Crystal tile (smashes Crystal if present).

setup.piece: Awakened piece near board; begin underground
setup.first-turn: Place Sleeping Dragon on Knight tile (or Entrance if no Knight)

turn-summary.phase: Replace Hand (draw cards equal to Spirit)

statistics.armor: Defense vs attacks and some effects outside your turn.
statistics.spirit: Power cards drawn at end of turn for new hand.

gems-other-players.knight: Roll die: center −2 Grit; else +5 Grit. Return Gem to Dragon.
gems-other-players.goblins: Center: scatter. Else: may plunder. Return to Dragon after resolution.
gems-other-players.thief: Center: killed (no Loot Drop). Else Thief may spend another Action cube to skip roll; else take and stash. Until stashed, Dragon may use Gem symbol. Stashed → supply. Killed before stash: Gem on tile.

phase.free-move: 1 or 2 tiles straight line once per turn without Power cards; before or after powers.
phase.powers: Discard Power cards matching symbols on board. Any powers, any times, paying each cost. Question mark cost = any symbol.
phase.dragon-gems-on-map: Each Gem’s symbol once per turn; spending does not remove Gem; may flip facedown spent, flip up at end of turn.
phase.movement-underground: Enter Dark; move through walls; entering another player does not prompt their attack.
phase.movement-surface: Cannot enter Dark or through walls. Entering Knight or Goblin: attack only if their Strength allows attack (Goblin > Armor; Knight ≥ Armor).

killing-goblins.rule: Claw, Scratch, Hiss vs Goblins: increase Eaten Goblins by total Population lost.

killing-thief.rule: Claw or Scratch kills Thief: draw Power cards = Loot Drop Level.

phase.rule: After all movement, pick up Treasure on your tile.
First Treasure per turn: give to Cave for Greed (move cube Greed → Wakefulness).
Multiple Treasures: keep beyond first; give one per later turn.
All four Sloth cubes removed from Greed: return further Treasures to Cave without effect.
Place Dragon Gem of your choice on current Cave tile if you have any.
Discard remaining; shuffle all Power cards; draw cards = Spirit.

tracks.greed: Pick up Treasure, return to Cave (4 cubes on track)
tracks.pride: Reveal Event tile (4 cubes); OR don’t move (1 cube); OR place Dragon Gem while ≥1 Gem on map (1 cube)

awakening.rule: Up to 3 Sloth cubes per turn, only 1 per Sloth track. All Pride conditions share Pride track.
11+ cubes on Wakefulness: awaken. Replace Slumbering with Awakened piece. Cannot fall asleep again.

surfacing.rule: When awake, end turn on Crystal tile to surface (smashes Crystal).
Surface: entering others resolves attack as if they attacked you (see Knight/Goblins).
Win: surface then move onto Entrance.

powers-summary.power: Roll Dragon die. Goblins scatter; eat Goblins equal scattered Population; move Knight 1; Thief killed.
Roll die; reveal affected Dark tiles.
Move up to 2 straight or 1 through wall.
Force Goblin Tribe anywhere hidden, −1 Population; eat 1 Goblin.
Move Sloth cube between Sloth tracks with empty space.
Move Gem or Treasure on adjacent space 5 spaces any direction.
Reveal any Dark tile on map.
Move Knight from adjacent up to 3 spaces.
Place Shriek token; when rolling Dragon die may spend to reroll.
Attack Knight, all Goblin Tribes, or Thief on tile: Knight −5 Grit; Goblins to 0 Population and eat; Thief killed.
Adjacent visible tile; entering: Knight −5 Grit; Goblin −1 Population; Thief killed; Dragon immune. Return token start of next turn.
Roll die; Collapse tile; scatter Goblins; move others adjacent; reconnect if split.

role.note: Full costs printed on Dragon board (Armor | Spirit pairs per row).
While surfaced or during Collapse, Knight can attack without Bomb; multiple attacks per turn on surface.
